Review follow-up of #32534 (PR #32877, contract review PASS on `bc9dbb61`, delta PASS on `8564eaac`). Findings filed instead of a rework round.

Blocked-by: #32877

## Do

- ~~**S3**~~ moved into PR #32877 by the epic seat's red-line ruling (one rule closes it: release only the names the owner no longer holds after the engine's removal). This card keeps N4 only.
- **N4 — runtime pre-seal re-bind pin.** The re-bind-before-the-seal row is pinned only at the registry method, not through a runtime re-bind before the seal. Add the runtime pin.

- **D2-N1 — move-path ordering pin.** No runtime test pins that the release runs after the old owner's kept functions are registered again. It matters when the old owner keeps a previous function the new bind neither moves nor gives back to it: only the ordering keeps its claim. Add one runtime CONTROL for that state plus the matching ablation (release before re-register → red).
  - The epic red-line delta read (record 6840550973, N5) measured the same gap from the other side: moving the engine question in `releaseMovedFunctions` to right after the unregister (its ablation A11) keeps runtime 34/34 green while three cells return to the F1 state. The CONTROL should fail under that ablation too.
- **Numbering.** The runtime pins skip (iii); renumber when touching the file.
- **D2-N2 — owner-spelling order.** The double-registration pins (bare package id beside `app:<id>`) cover only the order where the bare-id registration comes last. In the other order the engine's shared holder entry is replaced first, so the release correctly frees the claim; pin that order too, and qualify the changeset-level wording "still holds under another owner spelling" as "in the engine's holder set" at the next change touching it.

## Constraints

- Ruling A 6824698376: a disabled package is still a holder; releasing applies only to an owner's own claims.
- Red line 2: no path picks one holder of a bare name.

Reader who acts: `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` (`releaseBareNameFunctions`, `releaseMovedFunctions`), `packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.ts` and their tests.
Dedupe: card #32907 is the bare read with the platform plus one package; this card is the release side only.
